contracts.name: Armored Husk
contracts.printedText:
When Armored Husk enters the field, choose a target manifestation on the field. That manifestation is Protected from cards and effects controlled by the opponents.
In the End Phase, you can exhaust this card and pay {G}: Change the target of the effect of this card.

contracts.name: Hot Potato
contracts.printedText:
When the Hot Potato enters the field, it passes under the control of a target opponent with a Burn counter on it.
The player who controls the Hot Potato can pay a number of {H} essences equal to how many Burn counters are on it: The Hot Potato passes under the control of a target opponent with one more Burn counter.
At the end of the turn, the player who controls it loses 40 points, then the Hot Potato is destroyed.
selectedClauses: When the Hot Potato enters the field, it passes under the control of a target opponent with a Burn counter on it.
